## Emergency triage → domain:ui · priority:p0

Labels written after this comment: `domain:ui` · `priority:p0` · `bug` · `pm:queue`. No assignee.

### What was verified (read-only)

- **The break is real, and it is the only root.** `git show origin/main:packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx` (objectui `main` `5ea623ea`): line 82 is `const NAV_TYPE_META: Record<NavigationItemType, { labelKey; color; Icon }>`. It has nine keys (`object`, `dashboard`, `page`, `report`, `url`, `component`, `group`, `separator`, `action`) and no `doc`. `NavigationItemType` is `SpecNavigationItem['type']` (`packages/types/src/app.ts:75`), so the spec's union flows straight into this `Record`.
- **The spec side.** On objectstack `origin/main` (`bfa23a8f`), `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` declares `DocNavItemSchema` (`navItemSurface('doc')`, line 685). It is a member of `NavigationItem`, `NavigationItemInput` and the `NavigationItemSchema` discriminated union, which now has ten members. It was introduced by `ccccdcc35eac` (objectstack#19789), an ancestor of `main`. ⚠️ The time in this card's body is that commit's date. The PR's `merged_at` is 2026-09-24T15:44:26Z.
- **The gate on `main`.** `GET /commits/5ea623ea/check-runs?check_name=Spec Main Shape Gate` returns run `107717320697`: failure, completed 2026-09-24T16:13:29Z, with 20 annotations. It compiled against objectstack `67ebc84a7fa5`, which contains `ccccdcc35eac`. The one root diagnostic is `NavigationDesigner.tsx:82` TS2741, 「Property 'doc' is missing in type … but required in type 'Record<"object" | … | "doc", …>'」. The rest are a cascade: `plugin-designer` `build` exited 1, which gives TS7016 on `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 75–77, plus step-failure lines.
- **Control on open PR heads.** Gate runs that started before the merge are green (#10278, #10264, #10279). Runs that started after it are red (#10292, #10285, #10284, #10273, #10253), and three are in progress. ⇒ Every PR head and `main` reads red until this lands.
- **No other compile break over the union.** `git grep` over `packages/**` and `apps/**` found one `Record<NavigationItemType, …>` (this one) and no `NavigationItem['type']`-keyed map, mapped type or `never` exhaustiveness check. The switches are compile-safe because each ends in `default:`: `layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx:566` (`doc` falls to `#`) and `app-shell/src/views/studio-design/navSurface.ts:78` (`doc` falls to `null`). The `Record<string, …>` tone maps are also compile-safe: `app-shell/…/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx` `KIND_TONE` (a `doc` item takes the amber `untyped` tone) and `plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx` `TYPE_BADGE_COLORS`. `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts:75` `NavigationItemTypeSchema` is a hand-written nine-member enum without `doc`. It is a runtime vocabulary, not a compile break. These are product gaps for objectui#10188, ⛔ not this card. ⚠️ This is a static reading. Anything the `plugin-designer` build failure masks downstream will show up on the fix PR's own gate run.

### Lane: `domain:ui`

objectui cards route by where the fix lands (`cross-repo-coordination.md`). The fix lands in the published `@object-ui/plugin-designer` (`NavigationDesigner.tsx`, `hooks/useDesignerTranslation.ts`) and `@object-ui/i18n` (the locale packs). That is the residual stream, so it goes to `domain:ui`. 「症状位置不改流向」 (the symptom's location does not change the lane): the red is a CI gate, but no gate script changes. That is the difference from objectui#10229, whose fix landed in `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` and went to `domain:devx`. There is no `packages/types` edit either, because the type already derives from the spec, which is why this went loud.

### Grade: `priority:p0`

By consequence. The gate is advisory, so the queue is not blocked. But every seat's landing rule requires every check green or an expected skip, and the red sits on `main`'s own code. ⇒ No seat can land any PR in this repo until this lands, and rebasing does not help: a wall, not a tax. That places it under NORTH-STAR rule 3: an instrument that unblocks product P0/P1 landings inherits their grade. objectui#10229 was raised to p0 on the same ground, for a repo-wide landing halt. As a product defect alone (the designer has no badge for a `doc` item), it would sit with objectui#10188 at p2.

### Fix shape (a lead, not a spec)

1. **`NAV_TYPE_META`** (`NavigationDesigner.tsx:82`): add a `doc` entry matching its siblings: `labelKey: 'appDesigner.navTypeDoc'`, an unused colour pair, and a lucide icon.
2. ⚠️ **It must compile against both specs.** The lockfile pins `@objectstack/spec` `17.4.0`, which is the latest published version and has nine nav variants with no `doc` (the packed tarball was read). A plain `doc:` key reds the regular type-check with **TS2353** (excess property) while it greens this gate. This was measured with tsc 6.0.3 on a reduced probe. `Record<NavigationItemType | 'doc', …>` compiles under both. The `| 'doc'` is dropped by the spec pin bump that ships `doc`.
3. **Label key:** add `appDesigner.navTypeDoc` to the `useDesignerTranslation.ts` fallback table and to all ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs. `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds the key set.
4. **Pin:** keep the map a `Record` keyed by the spec-derived union. ⛔ Never `Partial<…>`, `Record<string, …>` or a fallback. Add a test that every member of the spec's nav discriminant has a `NAV_TYPE_META` entry. That is spec ⊆ map, not equality, because the map carries `doc` ahead of the pin.
5. ⛔ Do not add `doc` to `QUICK_ADD_TYPES`: an empty `doc` item fails the spec's `requiredOneOf(['book', 'doc'])`. The editor, menu rendering and the tone and zod gaps above belong to objectui#10188, which builds on this card.

Channel: this triage was run through the **emergency direct triage** channel by the `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`), because this gate halts every seat's landing. Routing is otherwise the triage seat's. ⛔ No claim, assignee or dispatch is made here.

### Scope

The fix the emergency triage `5817984053` located:
1. `NAV_TYPE_META` gains a `doc` entry, typed `Record<NavigationItemType | 'doc', …>`. That compiles against both the pinned `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 (no `doc`) and objectstack `main` (with `doc`, objectstack#19789). The `| 'doc'` goes at the pin bump that ships `doc`.
2. One label key: the fallback in `useDesignerTranslation.ts`, plus all ten locales.
3. A guard test that every spec nav type has a map entry.

⛔ `doc` is NOT added to `QUICK_ADD_TYPES`: an empty `doc` item fails the spec's `requiredOneOf(['book','doc'])`, and that is objectui#10188's. ⇒ `Fixes #10287`.

### Why `Clause-②: no`

It widens no acceptance set: the designer draws one more existing spec member. It adds no export.
